relationships.rationale: Decision step 4: the BRDF circles (provider Level 1D) and the full flights (Level 1C) are outputs of the same CAR post-processing of the same flights; no document says the BRDF files are made from the L1C files. Mapped to CAR_SKUKUZA_L1C by campaign. All 3 BRDF flights have an L1C file.

metadata_findings: The only MetadataAssociation is SCIENCE ASSOCIATED to the record itself (CAR_SKUKUZA_BRDF 2): a self-relation, which should be removed.
No lineage associations; this run proposes RELATED CAR_SKUKUZA_L1C (parallel_product, MEDIUM).
The DATA SET LANDING PAGE (https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/catalog/ges-disc-m2tmnxchm-5.12.4) is the landing page of an unrelated dataset.
Flight 1903's BRDF granules are dated 20070101, but its L1C file is dated 20050520.
